newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Tianfa 96 net up 46 pct.
newsitem.headline: China Tianfa 96 net up 46 pct.

text.p: China's Hubei Tianfa Enterprises (Group) Co Ltd reported net profit of 44.25 million yuan ($5.33 million) in 1996, up 46 percent against 30.38 million yuan in 1995 according to Chinese accounting standards.
Turnover for the company, which sells cars and petrol, rose 20 percent to 257.76 million yuan from 214.15 million yuan in 1995, the company statement in Friday's Shenzhen-based Securities Times said.
Earnings per share was 0.68 yuan in 1996, up 44.7 percent compared with 0.47 yuan in 1995, it said.
Tianfa attributed earnings growth to a shift to wholesale from retail, improvements in product quality and aftersale services.

The company, which listed 65 million A shares in Shenzhen in December 1996, said it planned a 10-for-10 bonus issue based on the 1996 net, the statement said, adding shareholders will discuss the dividend plan on April 7.
